checked.comment: This is the stochastic N-armed Bernoulli bandit with i.i.d. rewards. The paper explicitly states the unique-optimal-arm assumption (as without loss of generality), and the algorithm needs no inputs.

This matches Theorem 1: (1+eps) sum Delta_i ln T / d(mu_i,mu_1) + O(N/eps^2). d is the Bernoulli KL, so kl_i is correct. The bound is on expected regret defined through the means (pseudo-regret). The algorithm does not use T, so anytime is correct.
This matches Theorem 2: O(sqrt(N T ln T)), with absolute constants hidden.
Beta-Bernoulli Thompson Sampling with uniform priors; registry id thompson_sampling_beta is correct.

summary: The extraction is accurate. Both theorems are recorded faithfully, with the right symbol mapping (N→K, d(mu_i,mu_1)→kl_i) and correct qualifiers. The setting and cited results match the paper. The remaining lemmas are technical and correctly left out.
